text:
NovaElectrics (customer): Hi — invoice 00012345 is stuck on hold. We uploaded a resale certificate and have two VAT IDs (GB999999973 and DE123456789). The system only picked GB and reverse-charge wasn't applied. Can you check? I uploaded the cert to the invoice thread.
Carla (Support): Thanks — sorry about that. Can you paste the account ID and the exact VAT IDs? Also when did you upload the file?
NovaElectrics (customer): Account ID AC-789-NE, VATs: GB999999973, DE123456789. Uploaded today at ~09:12 UTC (file name nova_resale_cert.pdf).
BillingBot: Evidence uploaded: nova_resale_cert.pdf (AC-789-NE) — processing queued.
Carla (Support): Looping in @Ben W (billing) to check why reverse_charge didn't set. Ben — initial look: our validator picked GB and set tax_applied=true. Could be normalization/primary-vat selection.
Ben W: @Carla can you share the billing-service validation log for AC-789-NE? Also did VIES return OK for DE? Sometimes VIES timeouts fallback to country heuristics.
Carla (Support): Here's the quick log extract I pulled:
```
[2025-06-12T09:13:01Z] acct=AC-789-NE validate_vat_ids ['GB999999973','DE123456789']
[2025-06-12T09:13:02Z] acct=AC-789-NE vies_lookup GB999999973 -> VALID
[2025-06-12T09:13:04Z] acct=AC-789-NE vies_lookup DE123456789 -> TIMEOUT
[2025-06-12T09:13:05Z] acct=AC-789-NE normalized_primary_vat GB999999973
[2025-06-12T09:13:05Z] acct=AC-789-NE reverse_charge_applied=false reason=missing_valid_vies_for_secondary
```
Carla (Support): So DE lookup timed out and system used GB as primary, which doesn't trigger reverse-charge because billing country is GB.
Dmitri R: tagging infra — we had an intermittent VIES outage in eu-west-1 around 09:13 UTC, likely the timeout. We should retry with backoff. @Ben W can apply manual override if needed.
Ben W: Confirm. I can set reverse_charge=true manually if you confirm legal name that matches the resale cert. Also need the uploaded filename; if the upload failed we can ask for re-upload.
NovaElectrics (customer): Legal name on cert is "Nova Electrics GmbH". The upload succeeded (says uploaded), file nova_resale_cert.pdf. Can you patch the invoice? We're blocked for payment runs.
Carla (Support): Thanks — I verified the file is present in S3 at s3://invoices-evidence/AC-789-NE/nova_resale_cert.pdf. Escalating to billing ops to mark invoice as exempt. Will update here when done. :pray:
Ben W: OK done — I set reverse_charge=true on invoice 00012345 and marked evidence_verified. Expect invoice to leave hold within 1–2 hours. I also added a retry job to revalidate the DE VAT for the account.
Carla (Support): Apologies for the disruption. Please confirm when the invoice moves to processing. If it doesn't after 2 hours ping me and I'll escalate to finance.
NovaElectrics (customer): Thanks all — invoice moved to processing now. Really appreciate the fast help. :thumbsup:
Carla (Support): Great — closing the loop. Filing a follow-up ticket to add better VIES retry/backoff and to surface multi-vat warnings in the console.
